title: FAA grounds flights at major Northeast airports after fiber line cut - Fox Business

title: California billionaire tax loses ground in new poll - Politico
description: Fewer than half of likely voters said they would vote for the tax on the assets of California’s wealthiest residents, according to a poll by POLITICO and its partners.

title: Todd Monken on Deshaun Watson: I still see him as a very young player who will continue to grow - NBC Sports
